articles.title: Caitlin Clark reveals the Taylor Swift inspiration behind her exclusive Nike friendship bracelet sneakers
articles.summary: Caitlin Clark gave Jimmy Fallon a closer look at the story behind her custom Nike sneakers inspired by Taylor Swift’s iconic friendship bracelets. During her appearance on The Tonight Show, the Indiana Fever star explained that the idea came from seeing fans bring friendship bracelets to her games. As a huge Swiftie herself, Clark wanted to turn that fan tradition into a special design of her own. Clark also revealed that no one else in the world owns this particular pair, meaning Taylor Swift herself has yet to receive one. However, she didn't show up empty-handed for Fallon, bringing him a specially made pair of his own. The sneakers are set to launch in February and will feature customizable charms, allowing buyers to personalize their shoes. A unique concept that could quickly become one of Nike's most sought-after releases.

articles.title: Villarreal 2-0 Getafe | Resumen
articles.summary: El Villarreal lo vio negro, mucho, pero salvó un punto de partido de manual. Un gol de Buchanan, cuando se habían jugado 80 minutos soporíferos, le dio los tres puntos a los amarillos cuando todas las miradas y los pitas de La Cerámica se habían dirigido ya al banquillo. El gol del canadiense le da una bola extra a Íñigo, al que se le había nublado el futuro. Al técnico le queda mucho para encontrar el rendimiento real de su plantilla, pero al menos se marcha al parón con el cargo asegurado y con tiempo para intentar darle la vuelta al juego. El gol de Romero, tras una acción de fantasía de Ayoze cerró el marcador y la agonía.
